reading_rule: Consume each row as a premise or falsifier before proof search. A result implied by a row is dominated; use the stronger row and continue toward the parent theorem. Route choice remains unrestricted.

results.exact_statement: Under exact natural D/C dynamics, eventual strict centring |E_n| < C_n, division-free normalised vanishing E_n/C_n -> 0, and eventual boundedness of (-E_n)_+, the signed centred state satisfies E_n = 0 eventually; the composed boundedNegativePart_sylvesterNext_eventually consumer then yields a_(n+1) = a_n^2 - a_n + 1 eventually. Periodicity is not assumed. The proof derives zero absorption from the exact defect identity, sends the eventually nonnegative branch to natural-tail stabilisation, and sends the cofinally negative branch through gcd stabilisation, scale reduction and the shifted CRT barrier.
results.hypotheses: Lean-checked under the three stated hypotheses. Eventual boundedness of the negative part is exactly the hypothesis that remains open.
results.why_it_matters: Reduces Erdos #243 to a single signed-state statement: exclude cofinally unbounded negative excursions.

results.exact_statement: Any counterexample to Erdos #243 has negative excursions with -E_n > (1 - delta) log2 log2 C_n infinitely often for every delta > 0, has divergent normalised negative mass, and has every multiplier overlap gcd(a_n, D_n) bounded by the next negative magnitude.
results.hypotheses: Derived from the exact dynamics; the profile is a necessary condition on any counterexample, not a construction.
supersedes: qualitative 'unbounded negative excursions' statements without a rate
results.why_it_matters: It tells you exactly how slowly a counterexample's negative excursions may grow, and it is the reason coprimality-only arguments are capped: they deliver only O(log C_n) rises, while the profile lives at log log C_n.

results.exact_statement: At every dynamically reduced exact tail step, with h_n = G_(n+1)/G_n and v_n = D_n/G_n: gcd(a_n, v_n) divides h_n and h_n divides gcd(a_n, v_n)^2. Lean also checks h_n u_(n+1) + v_n = a_n u_n, h_n v_(n+1) = a_n v_n, and h_n = 1 if and only if a_n is coprime to v_n. Hence every gcd-growth step is exactly an old-prime reuse event.
results.hypotheses: Lean-checked exact identities on the reduced tail.
results.why_it_matters: Turns the analytic question into an exact arithmetic bookkeeping problem about old-prime reuse.

results.exact_statement: A natural state tending to infinity with upward increments bounded by B cannot, at every strict rise, avoid all earlier members of an infinite pairwise-coprime modulus family; the proof uses B old moduli, a shifted consecutive CRT block and the first crossing. Consequently, for an exact LCM-state recurrence g_n U_(n+1) = U_n - V_n with V_n >= -B and centered identity V_n = D_n - (a_n - 1) U_n, the recurrence is inconsistent with U_n tending to infinity once an infinite pairwise-coprime family of old primes p > B is supplied.
results.hypotheses: Lean-checked. Avoidance away from strict rises is not assumed. Derivation of the prime supply from the original analytic hypotheses remains open.
supersedes: earlier bounded-rise arguments without the shifted CRT block
results.why_it_matters: The barrier is finished. What is missing is one supply theorem, and that is a self-contained target.

results.exact_statement: Coprimality-only arguments deliver at most O(log C_n) rises, while the quantified counterexample profile lives at (1 - delta) log2 log2 C_n. Therefore no argument that uses only coprimality of successive terms can exclude the surviving negative branch; the producer must use the congruence E_n = D_n (mod C_n) or a second landing mechanism.
results.hypotheses: Recorded in the priority-1 open producer as an exact cap.
results.why_it_matters: Rules out the most natural first attack before it is spent.

results.exact_statement: For the exact integral update C_(n+1) = C_n - E_n with positive C, division-free normalized vanishing plus summability of natAbs(min(E_n,0))/C_n already forces E_n = 0 eventually. Hence proving summable negative mass is not progress: it is a closed case. The surviving branch has DIVERGENT normalised negative mass by construction.
results.hypotheses: Lean-checked; the proof bounds the finite products of 1 + delta_n, hence bounds C_n, then uses integrality.
results.why_it_matters: Any attack that concludes with summable negative mass has rediscovered a closed case and must continue.

results.exact_statement: An exact counterexample bounds what a clean-recovery-length argument can deliver; the recovery-length route cannot by itself force the payment threshold. The upper repair budget is exact and multiplicatively accumulated; the missing direction is a LOWER bound proving infinitely many repairs force a payment product whose fixed power eventually exceeds 2^n.
results.hypotheses: Exact counterexample in Lean plus the measured cascade receipts.
results.why_it_matters: Names the exact direction of the missing inequality so the desk does not prove the easy side again.

results.exact_statement: Erdos and Straus, On the irrationality of certain Ahmes series (1964), Theorem 3 on printed p. 132, already gives the conditional equivalence between rationality and the eventual Sylvester recurrence under condition (i) and limsup (N_k/n_(k+1))(n_(k+1)^2/n_(k+2) - 1) <= 0. Duverney 2001 Corollary 3.2 on printed p. 287 gives a further conditional criterion. Neither may be claimed as new, and a positive-part limit formulation is a derived sufficient condition, not the authors' literal statement.
results.hypotheses: Source identity and pagination verified against the complete scans.
supersedes: unattributed restatements of the conditional criterion
results.why_it_matters: The conditional criterion is printed. Only the removal of the extra hypothesis is new.
